rows.label: Chipset
rows.value: AMD B650E

rows.label: Processeurs / socket
rows.value:
Socket AM5 support AMD Ryzen™ 7000 / 8000 / 9000 series Processors
 
Support for future AMD Ryzen processors with BIOS update
 
* Please refer to www.biostar.com.tw for CPU support list.

rows.label: Mémoire
rows.value:
AMD Ryzen 7000 / 8000 / 9000 Series Processors:
 
Supports Dual Channel DDR5 - 6000+(OC) MT/s, Non-ECC, Un-buffered Memory
 
4 x DDR5 DIMM Memory Slot, Max. Supports up to 256 GB Memory
 
Support Intel Extreme Memory Profile (XMP) memory modules and AMD EXTended Profiles for 
Overclocking (EXPO) memory modules
 
* Please refer to www.biostar.com.tw for Memory support list.

rows.label: Sorties graphiques intégrées
rows.value:
Supports DX12
Supports HDCP

rows.label: Stockage et restrictions
rows.value:
Total support 3 x M.2 Socket and 4 x SATA (6Gb/s) ports
 
AMD Ryzen 7000 / 8000 / 9000 Series Processors
 
1 x M.2 (Key M) Socket (M2M_CPU_1) :
 
Supports M.2 Type 2242/ 2260/ 2280 SSD module
 
Supports PCIe 5.0 x4 (128Gb/s)/ 4.0 x4 (64Gb/s) - NVMe/ AHCI SSD
 
1 x M.2 (Key M) Socket (M2M_CPU_2) :
 
Support M.2 Type 2280 SSD module
 
Support PCIe 5.0 x 4 (128Gb/s) / 4.0 x 4 (64Gb/s) - NVMe / AHCI SSD
 
AMD B650 Chipset
 
1 x M.2 (Key M) Socket (M2M_SB) :
 
Support M.2 Type 2280 SSD module
 
Support PCIe 4.0 x 4 (64Gb/s) - NVMe / AHCI SSD
 
4 x SATA III Connector (6Gb/s) 
 

* Specifications vary by CPU types

Realtek RTL8125B
 
10/ 100/ 1000/ 2500 Mb/s auto negotiation, Half / Full duplex capability

7.1 Channels, High Definition Audio, Hi-Fi

rows.label: USB
rows.value:
1 x USB 3.2 Gen2x2 Type-C port (1 on rear I/Os)
 
5 x USB 3.2 Gen2 port (3 on rear I/Os and 2 via internal headers)
 
2 x USB 3.2 Gen1 port (2 on rear I/Os)
 
6 x USB 2.0 port (2 on rear I/Os and 4 via internal headers)

Les restrictions CPU/BIOS, partage PCIe/M.2, limites de mémoire et conditions de connectique sont conservées dans le texte officiel.
Le compteur M.2 ne retient que les sockets de stockage explicitement PCIe/NVMe ; les sockets Wi-Fi Key E et SATA seuls sont exclus.
L’archive ne précise pas de révision de PCB. Les versions officiellement accessibles restent identifiées séparément ; seuls les faits communs sont projetés dans les métadonnées.
